serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Lady Annalie: Uoohhhhhh!
Lady Annalie: So after all this looking you didn’t buy anything after all! Is my shop lacking something?
Oh man… {{wi}}She’s kinda a pain to deal with…
You: I-It’s not like that! Everything is great, it’s just…{{wi}} I’m sure I will buy something next time. {{wi}}Probably.
#Annalie.Face.normal
Lady Annalie: So there will be a next time! That’s great to hear!
#Annalie.Face.sad
Lady Annalie: I don’t know why but not many people visit my shop. Especially the second time.
Lady Annalie: Maybe I’m not up to date with the newest trends? I read all the fashion magazines though?
I think I know the reason.{{wi}} You are scaring people off, you weirdo!
You: You are doing great! People these days just can’t appreciate good service.
Lady Annalie: *sniff* Do you really think so?
You: Sure!
#Annalie.Face.normal
Lady Annalie: Hahaha, maybe I was wrong about you after all. Please come again. Bye~
You: Bye!
#Annalie.animate(TransparencyTo0,0.4)
